cover_letter.greeting: Dear Citi Ventures Investor Operations Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Investor Operations role at Citi Ventures. I am completing an MBA in Finance (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli, after working at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Citi Ventures interests me because the team sits between early-stage companies and the rest of Citi, and Investor Operations keeps that work consistent across investing, partnerships and business development.

Two parts of my background fit this seat. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget and capital allocation across marketing channels, tracking KPIs on underperforming initiatives and moving funding toward higher-yield ones, which drove a 1.5x increase in performance metrics. I also prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership. At Lenovo I created AI powered dashboards and pitch materials, and built scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%. My work there was close to the people using the numbers, so I learned to keep reporting accurate and useful.

That is the same habit this role needs: tracking actions, keeping scorecards and leadership materials current, and flagging where a process can run better. I am comfortable working with Finance and other partner teams, and I would be glad to help the team adopt new tools. I would welcome the chance to talk.
